English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #fake Viral Posts Falsely Claim Singer Shihan Mihiranga Has Ordained as a Buddhist Monk False False social media posts claiming Sri Lankan singer Shihan Mihiranga has ordained as a Buddhist monk are fabricated : FactSeeker confirmed he remains active in his music career. by Anonymous | July 7, 2026 Claim: A picture collage shared widely on social media proves that popular Sri Lankan singer Shihan Mihiranga has ordained as a Buddhist monk. Verdict: FALSE Context In early July 2026, posts began circulating on Facebook alleging that renowned Sri Lankan vocalist Shihan Mihiranga had permanently stepped away from the music industry to enter the Buddhist monkhood. The viral posts prominently feature a visual collage containing two images positioned side-by-side: The left frame shows Shihan Mihiranga in standard, casual civilian clothing. The right frame shows an image of a Buddhist monk dressed in traditional saffron robes, implying the individual is the ordained singer. Given the artist’s high profile in Sri Lanka, the post quickly gained traction, attracting thousands of engagements, shares, and public queries. FactSeeker initiated a systematic verification process to review the authenticity of these claims. Verification Process 1. Digital Footprint and Platform Analysis FactSeeker monitored the verified, official digital assets of Shihan Mihiranga across social media platforms- principally Facebook. Observation: The singer’s official Facebook platform has remained continuously active, undergoing multiple public updates following the appearance of the rumor. Facebook link : https://www.facebook.com/shihanofficial 2. Event Schedule and Professional Commitments Further scrutiny of the recent media announcements broadcasted by the artist’s official management confirmed that he is consistently fulfilling active entertainment contracts. Specific Evidence: Prominently featured on his public timeline is an active confirmation for an upcoming live appearance. The artist is officially billed as a primary guest performer for the “Mihiraviye Lantern Concert Festival” , scheduled to take over a live stage in Matara on July 10, 2026 . Additional Findings: In addition to this single event, several parallel promotional updates, corporate bookings, and cultural concert schedules continue to list him as an active commercial performer. The immediate timeline of future live concerts demonstrates that the singer’s mainstream vocal career has faced no suspension, adjustment, or abandonment. Conclusion Based on comprehensive data and schedule tracking, FactSeeker found zero corroborating evidence from institutional, religious, or official personal sources to substantiate the claim. The structural timeline of the singer’s upcoming commercial appearances confirms his ongoing professional status. Therefore, FactSeeker concludes that the digital collage and its associated narrative claiming Shihan Mihiranga has ordained as a Buddhist monk are entirely fabricated and false .
